about.body: The AJ27 is Jaguar's 4.0-litre naturally aspirated V8 petrol engine, part of the AJ-V8 family that powered Jaguar's flagship models through the late 1990s and early 2000s. It's fitted across two model lines — the XJ XJ8 (X308, 1997–2003) and the XK XK8 (X100, 1996–2004) — making it one of the defining engines of Jaguar's modern era before the switch to the 4.2-litre AJ34 and later 5.0-litre AJ133. The AJ27 was developed alongside the earlier AJ26 as a 4.0-litre V8 with notable improvements, particularly addressing the cylinder lining issues that affected some early Nikasil-equipped engines. The AJ27 (and the supercharged AJ27S variant fitted to the XKR) remains one of the most widely-recognised engines in Jaguar's modern V8 lineage.

byModel.body: The AJ27 is found in two primary applications. The XJ XJ8 (X308, 1997–2003) uses the engine in its naturally aspirated form, delivering the smooth V8 power that defined the X308 generation's character. The XK XK8 (X100, 1996–2004) uses the same naturally aspirated engine — and, in the supercharged XKR variant, the AJ27S with a supercharger added. Beyond these two core applications, the earlier AJ26 variant is also used in some early X308 and X100 models, though for rebuild purposes the AJ26 and AJ27 share the same engine family, components, and known issues.

compatibility.body: Because the AJ27 spans two different models — the XJ and XK — compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model and whether your specific vehicle carries the naturally aspirated or supercharged variant. A naturally aspirated AJ27 from an XJ isn't a drop-in match for a supercharged AJ27S from an XKR — ancillaries, ECU calibration, and mounting all differ. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle by registration.

items.heading: AJ26/AJ27 in the XJ XJ8 (X308, 1997–2003)
items.body: The AJ26 and AJ27 in the XJ XJ8 is one of the applications we work on regularly. The 4.0-litre V8 defined the X308 generation's character, and we've seen these engines through numerous rebuilds over the years.

items.heading: AJ26/AJ27 in the XK XK8 (X100, 1996–2004)
items.body: The AJ26 and AJ27 in the XK XK8 is one of the applications we work on regularly. The naturally aspirated 4.0-litre V8 powers the XK8, while the supercharged AJ27S powers the XKR — both applications are within our rebuild scope. Jaguar AJ27 by Powertrain Variant AJ26/AJ27 Naturally Aspirated Applications: XJ XJ8 (X308), XK XK8 (X100). Standard rebuild scope — timing chain components, bearings, gaskets. AJ27S Supercharged Applications: XK XKR (X100). Supercharged variants carry the additional supercharger ancillaries, which we account for alongside the standard rebuild scope.
